initial_image_clarification.text:
## Clarification of the two introductory images
The first image is an illustrative example with colored cylinders, not a view of your current room. The second image is an object-identification reference showing the appearance of each listed object. The objects' arrangement within that reference image does not represent their positions in the actual room. Neither introductory image is an observation of your current room or provides its actual object coordinates. Use Observe() to obtain real views of the room, and base your map on those observations.
